description:
The farmOS Field Kit app is open on the Tasks screen. Your task:
1. Tap the hamburger menu icon (three horizontal lines) in the top left corner to open the navigation drawer.
2. In the navigation drawer, find the 'Share My Location' toggle switch (it should be ON/enabled by default, shown as a blue toggle).
3. Tap the toggle to turn 'Share My Location' OFF (disabled).
4. Verify the toggle is now in the OFF position.
5. Close the navigation drawer by tapping outside it or pressing back.
